observations.finding: All 65 overview images, spaced every half second and including the final frame at 31.983333 seconds, were inspected. The five-person formation shows alternating low and high fan sweeps, traveling and rotating body phrases, changing skirt silhouettes, and a coordinated open-fan finish. All five bodies and fan extents fit the inspected overview compositions. No blank or corrupt sample, missing performer, missing prop or isolated disconnected cloth patch was observed.

All five encoded frames around each actual cut at 456, 917 and 1370 were inspected. Each camera switches at the derived cut frame, including the odd frame 917 omitted by the earlier even-frame proof. No blank exposure, obvious mixed-camera ghosting or full-figure clipping was observed in these neighborhoods.

All 19 frames from 1458 through 1476 were inspected in unscaled crops of the two left performers. Their fan planes progress through broad and edge-on projections near the faces and then overhead. Intermediate odd frames, including 1467 and 1469 around the 1468 maximum-speed sample, preserve connected grips and continuous arm, torso, skirt and visible foot positions. No isolated hand jump or detached cloth patch was observed.

All 22 frames from 1500 through 1521 were inspected in unscaled crops of the center and two right performers. The exact odd maximum-speed frame 1511 and neighboring 1509 and 1513 are included. The fan planes turn progressively past the face projections toward profile, with the grips remaining visually connected. Visible foot lifting and settling and the changing skirt silhouette follow intermediate poses without an isolated position jump. No obvious fan-through-body defect was observed in these sampled projections.

All nine frames from 1209 through 1217 were inspected in unscaled outer-left head and hand crops. The fan edge passes closely beside the head projection and the hand remains attached to the grip. No obvious visible fan-through-head defect appears in this ordered sequence. The separate numerical result remains a 4.870 mm overlap with the simplified head capsule and is not reclassified as physical mesh clearance.

All seven frames from 644 through 650 were inspected in unscaled crops around the center and inner-left pair, including the 647 minimum-clearance sample. Bodies and visible feet remain distinct while the fan projections overlap in the view and then change angle. No obvious body interpenetration or detached prop was observed. This visual finding does not establish three-dimensional fan-to-fan or full costume collision clearance.

The inspected native-size decoded crops preserve the luminous body surfaces, fan ribs and visible hand-to-fan attachment. This is a visual assessment of the lossy encoded master, not a claim of pixel equality with source PNGs.

scope_limits: Ordered still-frame inspection only. This reviewer did not perform real-time playback or audio listening; those activities belong in separate records.
